description: Filter Andrew's Kensington places by category, sub-zone, tags, featured picks or text, ranked like https://knowkensington.com/best/{category}. Every field carries its source; addresses, coordinates, hours, websites and photos are not included, so follow each place url for them. open_now only matches owner-supplied or official-site hours, and none are recorded yet.

category.description: Place category, for example coffee or restaurant

featured.description: When true, only return featured picks

open_now.description: When true, only places open now by owner-supplied or official-site hours

query.description: Text matched against names and Andrew's descriptions and tips

tags.description: Use-case tags; a place must carry every tag given

name: search_places
title: Search Kensington places
